question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Impudent
solution:
The correct answer is 'Respectful'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Impudent **is an adjective which not showing due respect for another person; impertinent.
 
• The meaning of the given options are as follows - 
 
 
• Respectful - feeling or showing deference and respect.
 
• Rude - offensively impolite or bad-mannered.
 
• Impulsive - acting or done without forethought.
 
• Bold - (of a person, action, or idea) showing a willingness to take risks; confident and courageous.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is evident that respectful is the correct antonym for the word impudent.
 
• Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.
